theorem.claim: Successful production fast-path bytes and original five receipt fields equal the literal B canonical/writer under all listed semantic, ownership and provider premises.
not_claimed: identical arbitrary failure or syscall traces
remote commit or actual-runtime custody refresh

B.meaning: maximum successful canonical encoded ASCII bytes per bounded call

R.meaning: maximum references in a sliced batch

D.meaning: wrapper-adjusted actual encoder/traversal depth; not merely the per-record admission counter

U.meaning: distinct exact row tuples in the original temporary set expression
U.owned_auxiliary_data: set table slots and references to preexisting rows

K.meaning: captured reference/runtime graph, fixed file metadata, paths, I/O buffers and scalar bookkeeping bits
K.generic_stream_counter_bits: Include O(log(total emitted bytes)) in K unless a fixed-machine representable-size premise bounds them.

E_runtime.meaning: maximum simultaneous encoder/provider storage for bounded successful calls, returned results and overlapping old/new results, including Unicode/ASCII, escapes, sorting and number helpers

assumptions.premise: Use exact named A/B/S bytes recorded in INPUTS.json, original B canonical/writer and original EXPECTED; any future edit invalidates dependent review.
assumptions.limit: No remote refresh or executing-stage custody established.

assumptions.premise: Only exact built-in admitted values, keys, containers and rank shapes; no subclasses or user callbacks on the fast path; production fault=None.
Stable inputs, reference/runtime bindings and exclusive supported filesystem ownership throughout the call; no hostile mutation or mutation-and-restoration between freshness edges.
The actual canonical provider implements original sorting, separators, ensure_ascii, list/tuple arrays, exact integer formatting, default nonfinite handling and ASCII encoding.
assumptions.needed_before_W5: Actual module/callable origins, executable/build and immutable custody sealed by W3.

assumptions.premise: For k=bit_length(abs(n)), floor(k*30103/100000)+2 bounds digits and sign; k=0 covers zero; arbitrary-width estimation does not decimal-convert.
assumptions.not_implied: Actual conversion success or bounded provider scratch.

assumptions.premise: Original ensure_ascii escaping spends at most twelve ASCII bytes per Python code point plus quotes, including supplementary code points and lone surrogates.

Intended CPython-compatible binary64 shortest-round-trip formatter has at most seventeen significant digits, scientific exponent width at most three, usual fixed cutovers and default NaN/Infinity spellings; these imply a maximum below thirty-two bytes.

Both the original whole-value canonical calls and candidate calls complete required conversions and allocations, with sufficient recursion budget; fitting the per-record estimator does not guarantee that success.
Authenticate actual decimal digit-limit settings, build-selected large-int helpers and reachable conversion providers; establish their workspace before simplifying E_runtime.
Exact dict/set, tuple/int hashing and comparison use compatible bounded-table/stack workspace; sorting item/reference buffers are included in E_runtime.
assumptions.generic_rank_width: For w exact integers per row, rank event estimate >=8+3*w and per-record admission implies 11+3*w<=B; tuple/int payloads already belong to retained input.

assumptions.premise: To reduce the bound to O(B+R+C+D+U+K), prove actual authenticated provider E_runtime(B,D)=O(B+D), including intermediate buffers and conversion helpers.
Synchronous hashing and regular binary I/O providers do not retain every batch; their ordinary buffers and handle metadata are bounded and charged in K/E_runtime.

M_aux counts live auxiliary requested storage beyond retained inputs. Word/reference/header costs and counter bit storage are explicit; allocator-retained free arenas and process RSS are outside that expression.

Authentic public loading must freshly authenticate fixed complete transports, logical digests, schemas, tuple restoration and original counts; no authentic decode or eligibility observation occurred here.
Literal fallback is eager. Error string conversion precedes truncation and failure JSON generation precedes its length cap. W1 claims no all-path space bound or exception-order equivalence.

Independent W1-W4 reviews, actual-host sealed providers, fresh source/input/runtime custody, actual ledger, concrete new one-use admission, complete independent validation and actual accounting are required before W5; author freeze does not supply them.

size_distinctions: R is a count of references; retained record contents can be much wider.
B bounds ASCII output length per admitted canonical call, not Unicode capacity or numeric-conversion workspace.
Old/new slices and old/new encoded results can coexist; a memoryview holds its backing raw bytes.
C bounds each read object/request; old and replacement reads can overlap in expression evaluation.
U counts retained row-key references and set capacity, not newly copied row data.
Original whole witness depth includes wrappers excluded by per-record preflight.
The loader and validator have additional parsed/restored/retained lifetimes outside writer-only storage.
